editorialChecks.sourceScope: The article makes no changing product, price, regulatory, or platform claims, so no external source check applies. Spend, leads, paid loads, ticket value, and margin are explained as the reader's own records, not quoted figures.
editorialChecks.example: Fictional inputs: marketing spend $1,200 a month, 40 leads, 14 customers, $350 per customer, 55% gross margin. Expected display: $85.71 cost to get one customer, $30.00 per lead, 35.0% close rate, $192.50 gross profit per customer, $106.79 contribution after acquisition, 4.08x return on ad spend, verdict 'If close rate reached 40.0%, modeled cost per customer would be $75.00 without spending another dollar.' Contrast case with 6 customers: $200.00 per customer, 15.0% close rate, -$7.50 contribution, 1.75x, verdict at 20.0% and $150.00. Both labeled fictional in the article.
